messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout v2026-03-21-1 -> eu-west-1, 10% traffic. Change window active. Quiet period until +10m. Watch SLOs: p95 latency, 5xx rate, kvcache hit. https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/slo-dashboard :rocket:
chris: seeing p95 for /generate jump from 120ms -> 430ms on the canary shard. Noticed concurrent 429s too. :eyes:
elaine: looks correlated with kvcache miss rate spike. kvcache hit dropped from 98% -> 72% at the same time.
matt: thanks — pausing ramp. deploy-bot: Canary ramp paused (manual) by matt. Traffic stays at 10%.
chris: extracting quick logs — snippet:
```
kubectl logs -l app=llm-serve -n eu-west --tail=200 | grep "KV-MISS" | tail -n 5
[2026-03-21T14:08:12Z] KV-MISS key=ctx_987ms shard=canary
[2026-03-21T14:08:13Z] KV-MISS key=ctx_31ms shard=canary
```
elaine: KV purge job ran ~2m before rollout start in eu-west; might be bumping cold misses. Can we check GC timing and whether cache priming happened?
ops-bot: Noted. Alert rule slo-eu-west-5xx fired (threshold 0.8%) at 14:08:25 with 1.4% 5xx in 1m window.
matt: given the hit-rate/cold-start pattern I'm leaning to keep paused and route canary traffic to fallback model variant (quantized) until kvcache stabilizes. Thoughts?
chris: agree. fallback variant has slightly higher latency but far lower error tail. Recommend reroute for canary tokens only.
elaine: +1. Also recommend a quick cache-warm job: curl a sampled prefix set against canary to prepopulate KV. I can run that if we decide to reroute.
deploy-bot: Approved action: reroute canary -> model:open-7b-quant-v2 (compatible). Applying route change now...
deploy-bot: Route update complete. Canary traffic now split: 100% -> open-7b-quant-v2 for canary shard.
chris: initial telemetry: p95 dropped to 240ms, 5xx back to 0.6% in 2m. KV hit slowly creeping up (75% -> 84%).
matt: nice. elaine, go ahead with cache-warm job. Share command you run.
elaine: running sampler job now: `python infra/tools/cache_warm.py --region eu-west --targets /prompts/sampler-1k.txt`
elaine: done. warming shows kvcache hit 92% after ~3m.
chris: monitoring looks stable. Recommend resume ramping once p95 < 300ms and 5xx < 0.8% for 5m.
matt: agreed. I'll schedule a controlled ramp to 30% over 5m when condition meets.
deploy-bot: Canary resume scheduled by matt: ramp target 30% over 5m, conditional on healthcheck gate.
ops-bot: Health rule re-evaluated at 14:13:30: p95=235ms, 5xx=0.45%, kv_hit=92%. Gate=PASS.
matt: proceeding with ramp. tagging release notes: "eu-west canary paused then rerouted to quant variant after kvcache missstorm; cache-warm completed; resumed ramp."
chris: i'll keep an eye for any regression and will call for rollback if error budget trend reverses. :thumbsup:
elaine: adding a follow-up todo: add cache-warm preflight to future change windows for model reloads.
matt: noted. closing thread once ramp completes. :white_check_mark:
